LESSON: FICTION AND NON- FICTION 7.3.2 NON- FICTION: AUTOBIOGRAPHY

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 10
Subject: LITERATURE IN ENGLISH FOR LEARNERS WITH VISUAL IMPAIRMENT JUNE
Strand: Strand 7
Topic 7.3: Fiction and Non- Fiction 7.3.2 Non- fiction: Autobiography
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 4

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Fiction and Non- Fiction 7.3.2 Non- fiction: Autobiography, part of Strand 7 in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 10 LITERATURE IN ENGLISH FOR LEARNERS WITH VISUAL IMPAIRMENT JUNE.

Key inquiry question: What lessons can be drawn from an autobiography? 2. How can one write an autobiography?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Fiction and Non- Fiction 7.3.2 Non- fiction: Autobiography together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Creativity and imagination: This is enhanced as the learner links values in the autobiography to their own life.

● Self-efficacy: This is nurtured as the learner analyses and justifies their strengths and weaknesses while discussing and

emulating the values in the autobiography and writes their own life story.
